svg.text: Engineering Agents on a Unified Knowledge Graph — Snowflake Reference Architecture
classifies · plans · dispatches · normalises · gates · cites — writes no SQL, reads no schema
Analysis plan artifact (ADV_ANALYSIS_PLAN) — steps, budgets, discipline filter, KG_VERSION pinned · draft / executed / degraded / blocked
store once · serve narrowly · trust and scope are attributes, not separate repositories
scope: data domain (WELLS, PRODUCTION, SCADA, LAND, COST)
origin: authored · read by domain agents
equipment · job · failure classes · org units (IS_A / PART_OF)
one owner · used by every layer
canonical measures · grain · time policy · authority precedence
+ KG_SOURCE / sections / chunks · KG_TYPE_SCHEMA · validated writes (SP_KG_UPSERT_*) · consistency checks
calculation only — definitions live in the graph
Common Model — Integrated / Curated Data Sets
Knowledge is stored once; each consumer reads a narrow view. Extracted engineering content never reaches the vocabulary view.
Concepts are applied to an asset only when SP_EVIDENCE_GATE finds their required evidence — from any domain, a governed function, or user input.
